Context: II. Grounds for making ad hoc

## II. Grounds for making ad hoc  
appointments or promotions may be made under the following  
Ad hoc conditions:-  
1. Legal Challenges to Regular Promotions.If the process of regular promotions is contested in any Tribunal / Court and the case is pending, ad hoc promotions may be considered.  
2. Short-time Vacancies.If the regular incumbent has proceeded on leave for more than 45 days, or on short-term deputation of less than one year, the vacant post may be filled on an ad hoc basis.
